name: Contra Check
notes: Provisional beginner practice version for owner review (2026-11-19): one compact LF forward / follow RF back CBMP check on count 1, developing/holding the checked position through counts 2 and 3. This is the check only, not the standard complete contra-check exit to promenade. The bodies turn 15 degrees left while the moving feet retain their original directions. A 40 cm travel with 14 cm inward placement and 3 cm lowering is a modelling proposal, not a prescribed syllabus depth. cross marks the intentional CBMP foot order; dense footprint and full-leg clearance checks must still cover it. Follow with Contra Check Recovery (Closed), the owner-confirmed back-side-close over three counts.
